tagline: The official Seafile server, with its secrets generated on first start and MariaDB, Redis and the notification server built in.
description: Seafile is a file sync and share server with desktop and mobile clients, libraries you can encrypt on the client, and built-in wikis.
author: Junker der Provinz

tips.before_install: Set SEAFILE_SERVER_HOSTNAME, INIT_SEAFILE_ADMIN_EMAIL under Custom Installation before the first start.

title: Seafile
